question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**nothing**" means not anything; no single thing. (कोई चीज नहीं)
 
• The context suggests that Nicole felt there was nothing she could do despite her tireless hands.
 
• The other options: "**something**," "**mostly**," and "**everything**" do not fit as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** For a moment Nicole stood looking down at the Mediterranean but there was nothing__ to do with that, even with her tireless hands.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Something (कुछ)**: means a thing that is unspecified or unknown.
 
• **Mostly (ज्यादातर)**: means as regards the greater part or chiefly.
 
• **Everything (सब कुछ)**: means all things; all the things of a group or class.
